eq8_adjustment: sim_adj = cos(h+, h-) - E[cos(h_i, h_j)] over distinct pairs of completions from the same benchmark
cross_benchmark_adjustment: cos(h+, h-) minus, per layer, the mean over the four benchmarks of their layer-mean cosine for that model; this is what the published figures plot
shaded_region: mean +/- 1 population standard deviation (numpy std, ddof=0) of the per-question cosine similarity across questions, at each layer; not a standard error or confidence interval
figure8: population standard deviation across the four benchmarks' layer means at each layer; invariant to the cross-benchmark adjustment
